personality: 3 Editorial structure with 8 Hand-Drawn warmth and textures
personality_one_liner: A soft, warm, and precious family keepsake that feels like an elegantly handwritten journal, blending refined typography with organic textures and dusty rose accents.

spacing.rule: Generous editorial spacing with breathable vertical rhythms, avoiding dense card layouts. Soft padding around content to enhance the keepsake feel.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary with soft borders for elevation instead of glass, maintaining the matte paper aesthetic.
dont's: No blur or glassmorphism, as it contradicts the hand-drawn, tactile, and natural paper vibe.

screens.name: Home (Accueil)
screens.purpose: A visual dashboard centered around the symbolic 'Growing Tree' and daily engagement.

states.loading: A delicate, slow-spinning leafy sprig in brandSecondary.
states.empty: A barren but beautifully sketched tree outline, prompting the user to record their first memory to make it grow.
states.error: A soft text message 'Impossible de charger l'arbre' with a Retry button.

screens.layout: Editorial layout. A large, organic hero section featuring the symbolic Growing Tree (an illustration that gains moss-green leaves and dusty-rose flowers as recordings increase). Below the tree, a horizontal scrolling list of 'Questions of the day' (up to 3) in soft surfaceTertiary cards. A section below lists family members with elegant circular avatars.

screens.name: Record & Questions (Capsules)
screens.purpose: The core recording interface and question bank to prompt storytelling.

states.loading: A soft pulsing dot in brandPrimary.
states.empty: No questions selected; showing themed categories to browse.
states.error: Microphone access denied message with a settings link.

screens.layout: High-contrast minimalist structure but using warm colors. When recording: A large central timer in Cormorant Garamond, a real-time waveform, and a prominent dusty rose pill button for Start/Pause. When browsing: A grid of themes (Childhood, Love, Career) using brandTertiary tinted containers. Sticky primary CTA at the bottom to 'Start free recording'.

screens.name: Voice Album (Album)
screens.purpose: A chronological, private archive of all collected family memories.

states.empty: An elegant vintage photo album illustration with text 'Vos souvenirs s'écriront ici' (Your memories will be written here).

screens.layout: Scrapbook/Journal rhythm. A pinned filter row at the top (by Narrator, by Theme) using pill shapes. Memories are displayed as a vertical list of elegant cards (surfaceSecondary with a 0.5pt border) featuring the narrator's avatar, date, theme tag, and a soft play button. No heavy shadows.

screens.name: Capsule Detail
screens.purpose: Immersive playback of a specific memory.
screens.layout: Cinematic yet soft. A cover image (family photo or brand-tinted gradient) with a gradient-to-dark scrim. The title of the question is displayed large in Cormorant Garamond over the scrim. Below the image: audio scrubber, play/pause controls, and text notes. The layout feels like a page from a premium novel.

home_hero_tree_empty.alt: A delicate dusty rose and green botanical painting

album_empty_state.alt: A nostalgic still life of vintage photographs and letters

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Blue and purple are completely banned. Use the deep warm brown (#3A332C) instead of black for text to maintain the soft aesthetic.
Implement the 'Growing Tree' on the Home screen as a central visual element. It should visually scale or change state (more leaves/flowers) based on the number of capsules recorded.
Ensure headings use Cormorant Garamond (max weight 500) and body text uses DM Sans. Never use bold/heavy font weights; rely on font size for hierarchy.
Borders should be used instead of shadows to separate elements, keeping a flat, matte-paper editorial feel.
For any image with text overlaid (like the Capsule Detail header), you MUST apply the top-to-bottom vertical linear gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to ensure text readability.
The audio recorder should feature a prominent timer and a simple, highly visible waveform, prioritizing usability for all family members.
Remember the app is exclusively in French. All placeholder text, empty states, and labels must be in French.
For the bottom tabs, use outlined inactive and filled active states for the Phosphor icons.
